tools.name: audit_ai_visibility
tools.description: Score how discoverable a website is by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews) and AI agents. Returns a 0-100 score, per-category scores and a prioritized fix list.

tools.name: audit_seo

tools.name: check_core_web_vitals
tools.description: LCP, INP and CLS for a URL from Google PageSpeed Insights (mobile): Chrome UX Report field data (75th percentile, 28 days) when Google has it, plus Lighthouse lab metrics and the biggest speed opportunities. Takes up to a minute.

tools.name: generate_ai_visibility_files
tools.description: Generate ready-to-publish llms.txt, an AI-bot-friendly robots.txt and schema.org JSON-LD for a website, based on its current homepage.

tools.name: check_ai_crawler_access
tools.description: Check which AI crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and more) a site's robots.txt and firewall/CDN let in. Flags blocked AI search bots, which cost citations.

tools.name: validate_llms_txt
tools.description: Fetch a site's llms.txt (pass the site URL, or a URL ending in /llms.txt or /llms-full.txt for a subpath file) and check it against the llmstxt.org format: H1, summary, H2 link lists, Optional section.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: List RankRoot plans (free scan, Launch Kit one-time, Growth Tracker monthly or yearly, done-for-you Growth Employee monthly or yearly) with prices, limits, checkout links and which plan fits which user. Agents with a USDC wallet can pay directly over x402: GET https://getrankroot.com/api/agent/check

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Get the Dodo Payments checkout link for one RankRoot plan, to hand to the user. The user pays on Dodo Payments and receives a license key by email; pass it as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' for higher API/MCP limits. If checkoutOpen is false, the plan is not on sale yet: the link is its pricing card

tools.name: list_launches
tools.description: Find software products for a need: new SaaS, AI tools and apps launched on RankRoot, each with a fact-checked profile (what it does, who it's for, pricing when published). tools.name: amplify_preview
tools.description: Write native posts for X, LinkedIn and Threads from any public page, in up to 3 languages, so the user can see what RankRoot Amplify would publish. Free, no key. Nothing is stored or posted.

tools.name: amplify_status
tools.description: Connected channels, languages, mode, guardrails, post counts and what has performed best for this customer. Needs the customer's Growth Employee key.

tools.name: amplify_list_posts
tools.description: Posts newest first, with status (draft, scheduled, published, failed, rejected), schedule time, live URL, warnings, claims to confirm and engagement metrics.

tools.name: amplify_edit_post
tools.description: Change a draft's text, thread or title. The platform checks (length, hashtags, hype words, required settings) run again and come back as warnings.

findings.detail: Description of "get_checkout_link" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_seo, check_core_web_vitals, validate_llms_txt, get_pricing, get_checkout_link, amplify_list_posts · Private data: generate_ai_visibility_files, validate_llms_txt, get_pricing · Public sink: generate_ai_visibility_files, get_pricing, get_checkout_link, submit_launch, amplify_preview, amplify_status, amplify_create_campaign, amplify_edit_post · Destructive: validate_llms_txt, amplify_edit_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_seo, check_core_web_vitals, validate_llms_txt, get_pricing, get_checkout_link, amplify_list_posts · Private data: generate_ai_visibility_files, validate_llms_txt, get_pricing · Public sink: generate_ai_visibility_files, get_pricing, get_checkout_link, submit_launch, amplify_preview, amplify_status, amplify_create_campaign, amplify_edit_post · Destructive: validate_llms_txt, amplify_edit_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
